BL-843 — Bubble Control, slice B — the Control page: a remote HTML pager page with the status line, the three stop/start verbs behind confirm taps, the holiday switch and the Day/Evening/Night picks
Approval context: Two calls are mine.
1. PAGE ORDER. Talk (native, first), then the read-only pages BL-830 already ordered — Live, Pipeline, Health, Host thinking — then Notes, and **Control last**. Control is the only page that can end a swarm, and it should be the furthest thing from a pocket swipe. The intake lef…
BL-843 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-843" (or "reject BL-843 <reason>") to act.
